sn55.54:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sakkesu viharati kapilavatthusmiṃ nigrodhārāme.
sn55.54:1.2: tena kho pana samayena sambahulā bhikkhū bhagavato cīvarakammaṃ karonti
sn55.54:1.5: sambahulā kira bhikkhū bhagavato cīvarakammaṃ karonti
sn55.54:1.7: atha kho mahānāmo sakko yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho mahānāmo sakko bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
sn55.54:1.9: sambahulā kira bhikkhū bhagavato cīvarakammaṃ karonti
sn55.54:1.11: na kho netaṃ bhante bhagavato sammukhā sutaṃ sammukhā paṭiggahitaṃ
sn55.54:1.12: sappaññena upāsakena sappañño upāsako ābādhiko dukkhito bāḷhagilāno ovaditabboti.
sn55.54:2.1: sappaññena mahānāma upāsakena sappañño upāsako ābādhiko dukkhito bāḷhagilāno catūhi assāsaniyehi dhammehi assāsetabbo.
sn55.54:2.3: atthāyasmato buddhe aveccappasādo itipi so bhagavā …pe… satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavāti.
sn55.54:3.1: sappaññena mahānāma upāsakena sappañño upāsako ābādhiko dukkhito bāḷhagilāno imehi catūhi assāsaniyehi dhammehi assāsetvā evamassa vacanīyo
sn55.54:3.4: atthi me mātāpitūsu apekkhāti. so evamassa vacanīyo
sn55.54:3.7: no cepāyasmā mātāpitūsu apekkhaṃ karissati marissateva
sn55.54:3.8: sādhāyasmā yā te mātāpitūsu apekkhā taṃ pajahāti.
sn55.54:4.2: yā me mātāpitūsu apekkhā sā pahīnāti. so evamassa vacanīyo
sn55.54:4.5: atthi me puttadāresu apekkhāti. so evamassa vacanīyo
sn55.54:4.8: no cepāyasmā puttadāresu apekkhaṃ karissati marissateva
sn55.54:4.9: sādhāyasmā yā te puttadāresu apekkhā taṃ pajahāti.
sn55.54:5.2: yā me puttadāresu apekkhā sā pahīnāti. so evamassa vacanīyo
sn55.54:5.3: atthi panāyasmato mānusakesu pañcasu kāmaguṇesu apekkhāti.
sn55.54:5.5: atthi me mānusakesu pañcasu kāmaguṇesu apekkhāti. so evamassa vacanīyo
sn55.54:5.6: mānusakehi kho āvuso kāmehi dibbā kāmā abhikkantatarā ca paṇītatarā ca
sn55.54:5.7: sādhāyasmā mānusakehi kāmehi cittaṃ vuṭṭhāpetvā cātummahārājikesu devesu cittaṃ adhimocehīti.
sn55.54:6.2: mānusakehi me kāmehi cittaṃ vuṭṭhitaṃ cātummahārājikesu devesu cittaṃ adhimocitanti. so evamassa vacanīyo
sn55.54:6.3: cātummahārājikehi kho āvuso devehitā vatiṃsā devā abhikkantatarā ca paṇītatarā ca
sn55.54:6.4: sādhāyasmā cātummahārājikehi devehi cittaṃ vuṭṭhāpetvā tāvatiṃsesu devesu cittaṃ adhimocehīti.
sn55.54:7.2: cātummahārājikehi me devehi cittaṃ vuṭṭhitaṃ tāvatiṃsesu devesu cittaṃ adhimocitanti. so evamassa vacanīyo
sn55.54:7.3: tāvatiṃsehi kho āvuso devehi yāmā devā.
sn55.54:7.7: paranimmitavasavattīhi kho āvuso devehi brahmaloko abhikkantataro ca paṇītataro ca
sn55.54:7.8: sādhāyasmā paranimmitavasavattīhi devehi cittaṃ vuṭṭhāpetvā brahmaloke cittaṃ adhimocehīti.
sn55.54:7.10: paranimmitavasavattīhi me devehi cittaṃ vuṭṭhitaṃ brahmaloke cittaṃ adhimocitanti. so evamassa vacanīyo
sn55.54:7.11: brahmalokopi kho āvuso anicco addhuvo sakkāyapariyāpanno
sn55.54:7.12: sādhāyasmā brahmalokā cittaṃ vuṭṭhāpetvā sakkāyanirodhe cittaṃ upasaṃharāti.
sn55.54:8.2: brahmalokā me cittaṃ vuṭṭhitaṃ sakkāyanirodhe cittaṃ upasaṃhatanti.
sn55.54:8.3: evaṃ vimuttacittassa kho mahānāma upāsakassa vassasata vimuttacittena bhikkhunā na kiñci nānākaraṇaṃ vadāmi yadidaṃ
